root_cause: Existing CP has no INFERPLANED_POLICY_DSN and reports a file-authoritative policy store.
proposed_change: Private PostgreSQL policy store plus a policy CP; preserve existing usage CP and memory history.

new_resources.database: RDS PostgreSQL 17, db.t4g.micro, single AZ, encrypted 20 GiB gp3, 7-day backups
new_resources.policy_cp: One ARM64 ECS Fargate task, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB
new_resources.routing: One added listener, target group and VPC origin on the existing NLB/distribution; five exact policy/SSO paths

exclusions: data transfer and incremental NLB usage
CPU credit surplus or additional backup storage

checks.main_template_changes: Distribution and new origin-ID parameter only

content_quality_gate.reviewer: Codex applying installed content-review-agent role protocol; no independent peer claimed

approval_block.action: execute policy-store CloudFormation CREATE change set
approval_block.reason: Persistent, billable production DB and network resources and ongoing costs were not explicitly authorized by the reported disabled-budget issue.

limits: No resources from this proposal have been provisioned; the existing UI remains read-only for budgets.
Actual DB bootstrap, new service health and live writable policy capability remain pending deployment.
Gateways must synchronize through the reviewed CloudFront CP URL, or receive an explicit endpoint update.
No live operating token or records were fetched; no local data backup is part of this plan.
Single-AZ/single-replica demo and legacy financial-profile limits remain; attaching a policy store does not enable durable global budget authority.
